name: frame-line2
description: 每日一部电影：由金句匹配电影并生成电影日签

scripts.build: npm run prepare-output --silent && poster build src/daily-movie.tsx -o output/daily-movie.html -t 电影日签 --json
scripts.export: npm run prepare-output --silent && poster export src/daily-movie.tsx -o output/daily-movie.png --engine chrome --scale 1 --json
scripts.daily: npm run generate && npm run build && npm run export
